test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following falls under Article 51A of the Indian Constitution?

options.text: Promotion of International peace and security

solution:
The correct answer is __**Fundamental Duties**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 51A** of the Indian Constitution specifically deals with the **Fundamental Duties** of Indian citizens.
 
• These duties were added by the **42nd Amendment Act** in 1976, based on the recommendations of the Swaran Singh Committee.
 
• There are currently **11 Fundamental Duties** listed under Article 51A.
 
• These duties encompass a range of responsibilities, including respect for the national symbols, cherishing the noble ideals of the freedom struggle, and upholding the sovereignty and integrity of India.
 
• Fundamental Duties serve as a constant reminder to citizens that while enjoying their rights, they also have obligations towards the nation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The inclusion of Fundamental Duties aims to instill a sense of **patriotism** and to uphold the spirit of **nationalism** among citizens.
 
• While Fundamental Duties are non-justiciable, meaning they are not enforceable by law, they act as moral obligations for every citizen to contribute to the nation's well-being.
 
• The concept of Fundamental Duties was borrowed from the **Constitution of the USSR** (now Russia).
 
• These duties are intended to complement and reinforce the Fundamental Rights provided to citizens in Part III of the Constitution.
 
• Understanding and performing these duties is essential for the harmonious and progressive development of society.
 
• The Fundamental Duties are detailed in Part IV-A of the Indian Constitution.
